home.layout: Sticky top nav with location + search, horizontal offer carousel banners, scrollable cuisine icon strip, then stacked sections (Top restaurants, What's on your mind, Popular chains, All restaurants) as responsive card grids.

restaurant.layout: Restaurant hero header with photo, rating, delivery info; two-column body with sticky left menu category sidebar and right-side menu item list cards with add buttons.

cart.layout: Centered single-column with restaurant header, cart item list with qty steppers, coupon input, bill details breakdown card, delivery address block, and sticky place-order CTA at bottom.

orders.layout: Single-column list of order history cards showing restaurant, items, date, total, status badge, and Reorder/Rate/Invoice actions.

offers.layout: Grid of offer cards (3-col desktop, 1-col mobile) showing large discount percentages, bank offers, Pro membership comparison section, and coupon codes list.
